title: Converbs I: after, before, without, until
summary: Link actions in time with a suffix on the first verb: **after** with `-Andan soň` (*öýe gelenden soň*), **before** with `-mAzdAn öň` (*ýatmazdan öň*), **without** with `-mAn` (*hiç zat diýmän*), **until** with `-ýAnçA` (*ol gelýänçä*, *men gelýänçäm*) and **since** with `-(A)lY bäri` (*bu ýere geleli bäri*), and tell a day or a trip as one connected story.
canDo: Say what you do after work, before bed and on the way
Say what someone did without doing something else
Say how long something went on: until the rain stopped, until dawn
Say how long something has gone on since an event
Follow and tell a short travel story
